content.json:
# MTTI / MTTR Dashboard

Mean Time to Identify and Mean Time to Resolve — the two north-star KPIs for this accelerator.

> This workbook expects a ServiceNow incident export table (`ServiceNowIncidents_CL`) synced to Log Analytics via Logic App or Data Connector.

content.query:
// Overall MTTI & MTTR tiles
ServiceNowIncidents_CL
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where Severity_s in ({severity})
| extend MTTI_min = datetime_diff('minute', IdentifiedTime_t, CreatedTime_t)
| extend MTTR_min = datetime_diff('minute', ResolvedTime_t, CreatedTime_t)
| summarize
    AvgMTTI = avg(MTTI_min),
    MedianMTTI = percentile(MTTI_min, 50),
    AvgMTTR = avg(MTTR_min),
    MedianMTTR = percentile(MTTR_min, 50),
    TotalIncidents = count()
content.title: Summary Tiles

content.query:
// MTTI trend over time (daily)
ServiceNowIncidents_CL
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where Severity_s in ({severity})
| extend MTTI_min = datetime_diff('minute', IdentifiedTime_t, CreatedTime_t)
| summarize AvgMTTI = avg(MTTI_min) by bin(CreatedTime_t, 1d)
| order by CreatedTime_t asc
content.title: MTTI Trend (Daily Avg, Minutes)

content.query:
// MTTR trend over time (daily)
ServiceNowIncidents_CL
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where Severity_s in ({severity})
| extend MTTR_min = datetime_diff('minute', ResolvedTime_t, CreatedTime_t)
| summarize AvgMTTR = avg(MTTR_min) by bin(CreatedTime_t, 1d)
| order by CreatedTime_t asc
content.title: MTTR Trend (Daily Avg, Minutes)

content.query:
// MTTI / MTTR by Severity
ServiceNowIncidents_CL
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| extend MTTI_min = datetime_diff('minute', IdentifiedTime_t, CreatedTime_t)
| extend MTTR_min = datetime_diff('minute', ResolvedTime_t, CreatedTime_t)
| summarize
    AvgMTTI = avg(MTTI_min),
    AvgMTTR = avg(MTTR_min),
    Incidents = count()
  by Severity_s
| order by Severity_s asc
content.title: MTTI / MTTR by Severity

content.query:
// Top 10 longest-running incidents
ServiceNowIncidents_CL
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where Severity_s in ({severity})
| extend MTTR_min = datetime_diff('minute', ResolvedTime_t, CreatedTime_t)
| top 10 by MTTR_min desc
| project IncidentNumber_s, ShortDescription_s, Severity_s, MTTR_min, AssignmentGroup_s
content.title: Top 10 Longest-Running Incidents
Auto-Remediated vs Manual Resolution
